title: SAP carve-out and ERP transformation powered by AWS
summary: Experience digital transformation powered by Cloud@Core. Read about how Sify's Cloud@Core platform helped a client achieve their digital transformation goals.
body_markdown:
#### A global steel manufacturer establishes a new SAP landscape on AWS following a business acquisition—completing the carve-out and migration within five months.


#### Project Objective


Extract the acquired steel business data and establish an independent SAP landscape on AWS.


#### Project Model


Managed-services-led transformation covering SAP carve-out, migration and ongoing operations.


#### Sify's Uniqueness


Integrated SAP, AWS, network transformation, managed infrastructure and application-management capabilities delivered through a single partner.


#### Integrated Value and Outcome


- SAP carve-out completed using a specialized SAP SLO-based tool
- APO, DMS and Enterprise Portal migrated to the new AWS environment
- Complete carve-out and migration delivered within five months
- Seven SAP-on-AWS projects delivered across S/4HANA, SoH, ECC and industry solutions
- Multi-cloud disaster recovery enabled through Sify's SAP-certified cloud infrastructure


#### Value for client


Accelerated separation of the acquired business, a scalable SAP environment on AWS, improved business continuity and consistent managed operations across multiple group companies.
